_note: Single source of truth for custom-story theme + length gating. An option unlocks only when the learner's furthest completed lesson rank >= the gate's rank, where rank = (5 - Nlevel) * 1000 + index (so N5.1=1, N4.1=1001, N3.1=2001; monotonic across levels). A learner's rank is floored at 1 (N5.1) — everyone can read that far. Consumed by BOTH CustomStoryBuilder.js (client greys locked chips) and story-gen/lib/story-gen-gates.js (server rejects locked requests before spending Claude calls). Theme keys MUST match CustomStoryBuilder.js THEMES strings exactly; length keys are the target-paragraph counts (LENGTHS n) and are ALSO the only targetParagraphs values the server accepts — an unlisted length is rejected as locked (crafted request), so keep these keys in sync with LENGTHS. Keys 6/9/12 are the legacy pre-rebalance client menu, kept so old installed bundles (and the server's missing-length default of 12) still generate at the equivalent tier.
